title: Community garden workday
scenario: Garden volunteers plan a weather-dependent workday, divide practical tasks, and clarify which spending and repair ideas remain proposals.
summary:
The garden group planned Sunday's volunteer morning around front-bed tidying, tool sorting, and labelling. Standing water ruled out work in the back corner, and a loose folding table would stay in storage. The session was set for 10–noon, with coordinators arriving earlier to set up. Available tools and gloves were discussed, along with borrowing additional gloves from a neighbouring group.

A mulch delivery had been offered but not ordered, and the group chose to plan the workday without it while checking how long the quote would remain valid. Weather and path conditions could still cause a postponement. A site check was planned for Saturday afternoon, followed by the coordinator's decision at 6 that evening. No alternative date had been chosen.
